{{Top|leg}}
'''Baran Wu''' was a [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] station on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. It was located in the northern hemisphere of the planet. An additional two million clones for a second generation were processed here and at [[Su Des]].
